base_prompt:
A high-end stylised 3D animated feature film, cinematic and colourful, family comedy-adventure tone, expressive cartoon character animation with squash-and-stretch, detailed fur and fabric, soft global illumination, rich saturated colour, shallow depth of field, anamorphic widescreen framing, smooth professional camera work.
Setting: a colossal four-storey brushed-steel filing cabinet floating in grey space like a tombstone, its large bottom drawer slightly ajar like a mouth caught open, side hatches and docking clamps. Lighting: cold, flat, grey fluorescent light.
In the shot: the Big Glitch-Bot, a towering grey filing-cabinet robot twice the size of the others, with a single large red sensor eye and one big square button in the centre of its chest.
Camera: Low angle on the Big Glitch-Bot.
Action: The Big Glitch-Bot floats forward, red eye blinking, its speaker-grille mouth flashing as it speaks.
Dialogue: The Big Glitch-Bot (deep, flat, booming monotone robotic voice, bit-crushed, utterly without joy, booming monotone) says: "ATTENTION, UNREGISTERED VEHICLE. YOUR COLOUR SCHEME IS UNAUTHORISED. SUBMIT FOR RECOLOURING."
Sound effects: feedback squeal, servo whir, ambience of mechanical hum, servo whirs, distant dot-matrix printers.
Audio: dialogue and sound effects only, no background music, no narrator other than the characters speaking. No subtitles, no captions, no readable on-screen text.
negative_prompt: live action, photorealistic humans, 2D flat animation, anime, sketch, subtitles, captions, on-screen text, watermark, logo, distorted faces, extra limbs, extra fingers, flicker, background music
